cards.front: What medication is recommended to prevent the incidence of reflex sympathetic dystrophy (RSD) following distal radius fracture ? Vitamin C
cards.extra: -AAOS 2010 clinical practice guidelines recommend this postoperatively -500 mg once daily for 50 days -Zollinger et al. (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17606778/) performed a double-blinded randomized controlled trial of 427 wrist fractures, allocating patients to receive placebo or 200, 500, or 1500mg of vitamin C for 50 days. The authors found that in the vitamin C group, the incidence of CRPS was 2.4%, while it was 10.1% in the placebo group. They showed no difference in relative risk between the 500mg and 1500mg groups. The authors concluded that Vitamin C reduces the prevalence of CRPS and a daily dose of 500mg for 50 days is recommended.
